intent: Fix logical managed climate control mode displayed as Off when Automatic/PID/Manual has an explicit supported or evaluated HVAC direction but physical output is idle and safely OFF. Keep the physical state separate; report idle action with armed mode, and never force native hardware on.
note: The existing managed climate hvac_mode mirrored physical state even though separate Control Method was PID/Automatic/Manual and Controller Status reported within_target_band. Beta36 changes facade presentation only: declared supported/evaluated HVAC direction remains selected while native device is OFF; hvac_action becomes idle. Existing/Off selections and unknown hardware remain conservative.
changes: Split ManagedClimate physical HVAC output observation from selected logical supervisory HVAC mode; preserve physical source state and original physical HVAC mode in diagnostic attributes.

For selected Automatic/PID, use the already evaluated native direction; for explicitly selected Manual/PID/Automatic use only supported requested mode; when only one native direction is advertised, allow that exact option without fabricating unsupported HVAC modes.
Show HVACAction.IDLE when the supervisory mode is selected but the native physical output is truly OFF, preserving physical OFF for idle periods and safety holds.
When Off explicitly selected, display Off; when Existing selected, mirror physical source and native HVAC action as before.
Do not touch EquipmentRuntime demand, duty cycle, native mode/ON/OFF writes, PID targets, safety interlocks, power ownership, acknowledgement or manual pause; preserve beta31–35 fixes.
Add regressions for heat/cool climate, fan, humidifier/dehumidifier logical HVAC idle, exact physical state attributes, explicit Off/Existing, unavailable source and no unadvertised modes.

One canonical environment_manager domain with no migrations; validate full Python 3.13/3.14 suite, native Home Assistant 2026.10, card, 38 language catalogs, HACS/Hassfest, and immutable flat beta payload.
